scripts.check: bun run check:format && bun run check:tc && bun run check:lint && bun run check:test && bun run check:build && bun run i18n:check
scripts.check:build: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=local doppler run -- turbo run build --filter='!@gamezilla/client'
scripts.check:lint: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=local doppler run -- turbo run lint
scripts.check:tc: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=local doppler run -- turbo run tc
scripts.check:test: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=local doppler run -- turbo run test
scripts.dev: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=local doppler run -- turbo dev --ui=tui
scripts.i18n:check: lingui extract && lingui compile --typescript && git diff --exit-code -- apps/client/src/i18n libs/lib/src/i18n libs/patch-db-example/src/i18n libs/room-example/src/i18n
scripts.preview: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=local doppler run -- turbo run preview --filter=@gamezilla/db --filter=@gamezilla/api --filter=@gamezilla/client
scripts.qa: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=local doppler run -- turbo run qa --filter=@gamezilla/qa
scripts.qa:api: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=local doppler run -- bun run --filter '@gamezilla/qa' api
scripts.qa:browser: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=local doppler run -- bun run --filter '@gamezilla/qa' browser
